name: Lodestar V0
rootCause: FlashLoan price manipulation - Incorrect logic in GLPOracle. The root cause is attributed to the construction of the Lodestar GLPOracle and how it obtained the price of plvGLP tokens. The GLPOracle failed to consider the impact of a user calling the donate() function on the GlpDepositor contract. This action inflated the assets of the GlpDepositor contract, consequently affecting the oracle-delivered price of the plvGLP token. As a result, the price reported by the GLPOracle became inaccurate due to the improper handling of the donation mechanism, leading to the vulnerability exploited by malicious users. descriptions.text: Lodestar Finance is the latest victim of the mass market manipulation that has affected both people and protocols across our industry. Lending pools drained for $6.5M put Lodestar at number 77 on the leaderboard.

FlashLoan price manipulation - Incorrect logic in GLPOracle. The root cause is attributed to the construction of the Lodestar GLPOracle and how it obtained the price of plvGLP tokens. The GLPOracle failed to consider the impact of a user calling the donate() function on the GlpDepositor contract. This action inflated the assets of the GlpDepositor contract, consequently affecting the oracle-delivered price of the plvGLP token. As a result, the price reported by the GLPOracle became inaccurate due to the improper handling of the donation mechanism, leading to the vulnerability exploited by malicious users. Arbitrum-based cryptocurrency lending platform Lodestar Finance was hacked and nearly $7 million in assets siphoned off, the attackers were able to manipulate the price of the plvGLP token, allowing them to use the inflated token to "borrow" the entirety of the Lodestar platform Liquidity available.

On December 10, 2022, Lodestar Finance on Arbitrum was exploited through an oracle manipulation attack targeting the plvGLP collateral. The attacker inflated the price of plvGLP, excessively borrowed platform assets, and exited with roughly $5.8M,$6.5M in value, leaving Lodestar with bad debt. The Lodestar GLPOracle contract allowed the price of plvGLP collateral to be manipulated via calls to a donate mechanism. This manipulation let the attacker artificially increase the value of their plvGLP holdings, enabling over-borrowing and platform drains in a single flash-loan-powered sequence.

The Arbitrum-based crypto lending platform Lodestar Finance was attacked by an exploiter who was able to manipulate the price of the plvGLP token, allowing them to "borrow" the entire available liquidity of the Lodestar platform with the inflated token. The attacker made around $6.4 million in profit. Some of the stolen tokens were burned —hence the difference between the attacker profit and the loss to the platform. According to Lodestar, they think they may be able to recover around $2.4 million of the stolen funds. Meanwhile, they have attempted to contact the thief to try to negotiate the return of stolen funds. "We will generously reward your collaboration," they wrote on Twitter.
